title: Decide whether a graph-snapshot load treats a store holding only a task-sync folder baseline as empty
outcome: Decide whether a graph-snapshot load treats a store holding only a task-sync folder baseline as empty
acceptance: A graph-snapshot load into a store whose only shared state is a task-sync folder import baseline either refuses as non-empty, or the docs state the ordering and a test pins that a later folder import then refuses (divergent planning or native state) instead of silently succeeding
